verdict.rationale: Zoho Invoice is a SaaS invoicing product, so a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair question. The evidence shows no such spec: every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404, and the API docs Markdown path also returned 404. The only machine-readable artifact found is a generic company-wide llms.txt, which is not an API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
